blogs.title: How to convert a PDF to word?
blogs.title_hi: पीडीएफ को शब्द में कैसे परिवर्तित करें?
blogs.content: Day in and day out people in offices need to convert PDF documents into some other formats such as .doc  (Microsoft Word) , .xls (Microsoft Excel Sheet), or .jpg ( Image format). Most often they know how to convert a word file into PDF but when the question raises “how to convert a PDF to word”, they feel uncomfortable about it. In real scenario, it’s actually a very easy task which can be accomplished by using an online service for file conversion known as Zamzar. However going for Excel and JPG conversion requires two steps, but again they are fairly easy to follow.
